title: Airdrie Christian Academy
description: airdriechristian.com Airdrie Christian Academy is a private K-12 Christian school founded in 1987 in Airdrie, Alberta, with over 1,250 students across full-time, shared responsibility and home education programs. Accredited by Alberta Education and ranked 60th out of 292 high schools by the Fraser Institute, it is the top-ranked school in Airdrie. Led by Head of School Andrew Casali, it offers 40 plus elective courses from robotics and 3D printing to woodworking and criminal science alongside Bible instruction and worship teams. The school represents 45 plus nationalities through its International Student Program and annual multicultural weeks. Tuition ranges from 4,085 to 9,345 Canadian dollars per year with the fourth child attending free and charitable donation receipts reducing tax costs. Its athletes compete at provincial zone levels and graduates pursue university, trades, professional sports and international missions.
